user.title: Pair Jukelet publisher
user.description: Enter the exact current app publisher UUID. Confirm new pairing, or explicitly reattach intact existing history after interrupted setup/removal. Reattachment never resets history or changes the publisher.

data.confirm_pairing: I confirm this publisher owns assignments and reviewed the installation state
data.reattach_existing: Reattach existing verified publisher history without resetting it

error.recovery_required: Existing or uncertain storage found. Restore the full HA backup; do not delete bridge storage.

abort.unsupported_version: This release supports HA Core 2026.10.2 and 2026.10.3 only. Prefer 2026.10.3; keep the backup and use a tested release.

confirm.title: Confirm recovery
confirm.description: Current revision: {current}. Recovery revision floor (history and validated snapshot): {floor}. Candidate publisher: {publisher}; revision: {revision}; checksum: {checksum}; mappings: {count}. A changed UUID retires the former publisher permanently. Empty mappings remove all bridge mappings. Dispatch remains disabled.

data.confirm_recovery: I reviewed the backup, publisher, content, revision and empty-mapping consequences

recovery.title: Recover or replace publisher
recovery.description: Stop the app publisher. Preserve a full HA backup. Paste a reviewed complete v1 snapshot from the authoritative app, using a revision above every retained publisher and the exact active base. This does not clear the app recovery guard.

init.title: Jukelet administrator controls
init.description: Playback controls and snapshot recovery are separate. Nothing here starts playback or changes legacy automations.

playback.title: Tag playback status
playback.description:
{state}

These are point-in-time observations. Refresh before acting. Enable never reconciles uncertainty, and reconciliation never enables. Additional scans while busy are ignored without replay.

enable.title: Enable tag dispatch
enable.description:
{state}

Verify that any legacy dispatcher is disabled in HA before enabling Jukelet. This control never changes a legacy automation. Readiness will be checked again. Confirmation expires after 60 seconds or an intervening state change. Enabling admits future intentional scans; it does not replay a scan or independently verify playback.

data.confirm_legacy_disabled: I have verified that every previous/legacy dispatcher is disabled

disable.title: Disable tag dispatch
disable.description:
{state}

Disable stops new scan admission. It does not cancel startup already in progress or prove nested/external work stopped.

reconcile.title: Reconcile uncertain startup work
reconcile.description:
{state}

Before confirming, independently establish that ALL previous startup work has stopped, including old/removed scripts, nested scripts and external work. Script entities being off, elapsed time, HA restart or an acknowledgment alone are insufficient. This clears only the execution fence and leaves dispatch DISABLED. A separate reviewed enable is required. Do not retry uncertain work blindly.

data.confirm_all_stopped: I explicitly confirm ALL previous startup work, including nested and external work, has stopped

control_result.title: Action result and independent readback

abort.recovery_rejected: State changed, history is unavailable, or recovery is unsafe. Read status and restart/review before retrying.
abort.control_not_ready: The reviewed control state is unavailable. Open the controls again and inspect fresh state; no automatic retry is performed.
